title: Comfort Colors My Knees Say No My Heart Says Pickleball Shirt, Funny Retro Pickleball Tee, Birthday Gift for Player
description:
The knees file a complaint every morning. The heart books another game anyway. A warm, funny retro pickleball shirt for every player who ices after open play and shows up again tomorrow.

Who it's for:
- Pickleball players who wear a knee brace (or should)
- Spouses, kids and grandkids shopping for a birthday, Father's Day or Mother's Day gift
- Anyone whose doctor and whose paddle disagree

About the design:
A vintage cartoon pickleball mascot in knee braces with wobbly knees, a sweatband and a bandage, giving a thumbs-up and holding a heart-shaped paddle. 'My knees say NO!' above and 'My heart says PICKLEBALL' below, with a subtle worn texture.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Cartoon pickleball in knee braces holding a heart-shaped paddle with the words My knees say no, my heart says pickleball on a mint tee.
